summary: Navigator Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, reporting that its subsidiary entered into a secured pre-delivery bridge facility of up to $164.64 million with BNP Paribas to finance 80% of pre-delivery installments for two newbuild gas carriers from Jiangnan Shipyard. Upon delivery in 2027, the bridge facility will convert into a $205.8 million JOLCO sale-leaseback, covering the full purchase price with competitive pricing. The vessels will be sold to special purpose lessors and bareboat chartered back, with Navigator retaining commercial and technical control and purchase options up to 8.5 years post-delivery. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
